integratedMotionWorkflow.harnessOnlyFinding: The final assertion incorrectly required log history from before a deliberate page reload to remain a byte-for-byte prefix. The harness now verifies complete history before that reload and the complete motion history after it.

responsivenessCorrection.observed: Two repeat runs reached ready 4.420 and 4.387 seconds after the first Stop.
responsivenessCorrection.cause: A new browser replayed the XRP's entire retained boot log through many small telemetry pages before handling ordinary controls.
responsivenessCorrection.correction: A new browser session reads one compact state snapshot, starts at the retained device-log tail, and then retains every new line from that browser session.
responsivenessCorrection.postCorrectionEvidence: The same integrated workflow passed the sub-three-second Stop boundary and proceeded through the motion assertions.
